# keycard_group_member (Resource)

Adds a user to a Keycard group. The user inherits every role assigned to the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "keycard_organization" "example" {}

# Add a single user to a group
resource "keycard_group_member" "engineering_lead" {
  zone_id  = data.keycard_organization.example.zone_id
  group_id = keycard_group.engineering.id
  user_id  = "user-id-123"
}

# Add several users to a group
resource "keycard_group_member" "oncall" {
  for_each = toset(["user-id-123", "user-id-456", "user-id-789"])

  zone_id  = data.keycard_organization.example.zone_id
  group_id = keycard_group.oncall.id
  user_id  = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group the user is added to. Changing this will replace the membership.
- `user_id` (String) The user added to the group. Changing this will replace the membership.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone the group belongs to. Changing this will replace the membership.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Group memberships can be imported using the format: zones/{zone-id}/groups/{group-id}/members/{user-id}
import {
  to = keycard_group_member.example
  id = "zones/zone-id-123/groups/group-id-456/members/user-id-789"
}

resource "keycard_group_member" "example" {
  # Configuration will be populated after import
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Group memberships can be imported using the format: zones/{zone-id}/groups/{group-id}/members/{user-id}
terraform import keycard_group_member.example zones/zone-id-123/groups/group-id-456/members/user-id-789
```
